svg.title: Adaptive music — Sections lane and Adaptive panel (proposal)
svg.desc: Music mode with the Sections lane under the ruler (Intro, Explore, Combat, To Boss), layer chips on the track headers, a pending transition from the next bar line to Combat, and the right-hand panel on its Adaptive tab: audition mode and target, parameter sliders, layers with curve chips, transitions in priority order, stingers and problems.
